judged_text: BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS entries are lowercased when parsed but the filter compares the raw guest email via blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest), so any guest address containing an uppercase letter bypasses the blocklist. With BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS='spam@x.com', a request adding 'SPAM@x.com' passes the filter and the booking's email flow sends ICS REQUESTs and notification emails to an address the operator explicitly blocked.
